title: Platypus Finance — Flash Loan USP Stablecoin Exploit Analysis

steps: 1 ▶ Aave Flash Loan (borrow large amount of USDC)
3 ▶ Mint large amount of USP using LP tokens as collateral
6 ▶ Repay Aave flash loan → Net profit ~8.5M USD
